controls.name: escape-honoured
controls.find: pub open spec fn excluded(n: Node, pattern_has_special: bool) -> bool { n.matches_glob && !pattern_has_special }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn excluded(n: Node, pattern_has_special: bool) -> bool { n.matches_glob }

controls.name: label-scoped
controls.find: pub open spec fn label_ok_built(n: Node) -> bool { n.label_here || n.label_elsewhere }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn label_ok_built(n: Node) -> bool { n.label_here }
controls.classification: decision: the label subquery is scoped to the graph (the repair)

controls.name: exclusion-ignored
controls.find: pub open spec fn excluded(n: Node, pattern_has_special: bool) -> bool { n.matches_glob && !pattern_has_special }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn excluded(n: Node, pattern_has_special: bool) -> bool { false }
